description: This PHP class 'GenericDateDisplayFieldWithAggregateDTO' provides a data transfer object for handling date display with aggregation capabilities in reporting. It implements string conversion and uses a date helper trait for formatting.

classes.name: GenericDateDisplayFieldWithAggregateDTO
classes.description: A data transfer object that encapsulates a date and provides a string representation formatted via a date helper trait.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with an optional date string, converting it into a DateTime object if provided.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a formatted date string using a helper trait method.
